_comment: Which station carries each broadcast network in the markets TV Thing gets television from (roku_control/networks.py reads it; control reads it when it starts).

antenna_market: the antenna's, its stations by virtual channel number. youtube_tv_market: where YouTube TV places the Roku, whose stations are YouTube TV's network rows (NBC, FOX...). If YouTube TV moves the Roku, change youtube_tv_market.

A market's name is how messages name its city, its label how blackout notes name the market. A station's label is how messages name it (its call sign unless given); aliases are other names a schedule gives its network.
nfl_teams: the teams whose regional Sunday CBS and FOX games the market's stations carry. nhl_teams: the teams ESPN Unlimited blacks out when YouTube TV places the Roku there.

affiliates: other stations the antenna gets, by channel, and their network (WNUV is Baltimore's CW). simulcasts: a team's games on a national cable channel that the market's station also airs, channel -> call sign.
